title: Repeat Installation Rate for Certificate Subscriptions
content:
**Managed Services rate notice: repeat installations, SSL/TLS Certificates.**

The per-certificate rate of a managed installation of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription depends on how many installations Harborline support has already made for that same subscription. That rate is the amount charged for each certificate the managed installation covers.

**How earlier installations are counted.** Each installation line in the subscription's certificate billing history counts as one installation already made. An installation line that a refund line of charge type installation has reversed does not count. Installation lines on other subscriptions do not count, even when those subscriptions cover the same name.

**Rate by installations already made**

| Unreversed installation lines already on the subscription | Per-certificate rate of the managed installation |
|---|---|
| two or more | 50 percent of the product's installation fee |
| exactly one | 60 percent of the product's installation fee |
| none | the product's installation fee in full |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical histories)**

- Three installation lines, one of them reversed by an installation refund: two stand, so the rate is 50 percent.
- Two installation lines, both reversed: none stands, so the full installation fee applies.
- One installation line and no refund: exactly one stands, so the rate is 60 percent.
- One installation line, reversed: none stands, so the full installation fee applies.

**Hypothetical figure.** On a product with an installation fee of USD 31.70 (an invented figure), the rate is USD 19.02 per certificate with one unreversed earlier installation (60 percent of 31.70). With two or more it is USD 15.85 per certificate (50 percent).
